authorInfo.bio: Michael Scott (1789–1835) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Tom Cringle's Log" by Michael Scott is a semi-autobiographical narrative likely written in the early 19th century. This book chronicles the adventures of Thomas Cringle, a young boy of only thirteen, as he embarks on a journey at sea that promises a mix of naval exploits, personal growth, and encounters with both camaraderie and danger.
